name: Sage Accounting (South Africa)
description: Sage Business Cloud Accounting, South African edition (the former Sage One): companies, customers, suppliers, items, tax invoices, quotes, supplier invoices, chart of accounts, bank transactions, customer receipts, ageing, profit and loss and balance sheet. Sign-in with your Sage login and an API key from Sage.

SAGE_ZA_API_HOST.label: Sage Accounting site
SAGE_ZA_API_HOST.help: The site where you sign in to Sage Accounting. Most accounts use accounting.sageone.co.za; pick the reseller site only if that is your login page.

SAGE_ZA_USERNAME.label: Sage login e-mail
SAGE_ZA_USERNAME.help: The e-mail address you sign in to Sage Accounting with. A dedicated user for the assistant is recommended.
SAGE_ZA_USERNAME.patternMessage: Enter the e-mail address of the Sage Accounting user, without spaces.

SAGE_ZA_PASSWORD.label: Sage password
SAGE_ZA_PASSWORD.help: The password of that Sage Accounting user. 20 failed sign-ins within an hour block the user for 24 hours, so check it carefully.

SAGE_ZA_API_KEY.label: API key
SAGE_ZA_API_KEY.help: The Accounting API key Sage issued for your application (a GUID). Request it on the developer page with the form Request your API Key; it can take up to 2 working days.
SAGE_ZA_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key as Sage sent it: a GUID such as 39478ac6-ac2a-44d8-a31c-7e7e14af4de3.

SAGE_ZA_COMPANY_ID.label: Default company ID
SAGE_ZA_COMPANY_ID.help: Optional. The numeric ID of the company the assistant works in, used when a call names no company. Leave empty at first and ask the assistant to list your companies.
SAGE_ZA_COMPANY_ID.patternMessage: Enter the numeric company ID only, e.g. 12345.

verifyHints.401: Sage refused the sign-in: check the e-mail address, the password and that the user can open this company. Do not retry repeatedly: 20 failed sign-ins within an hour block the user for 24 hours.
verifyHints.402: The Sage Accounting subscription of this company has expired. Renew it in Sage before using the API.
verifyHints.403: Sage refused the call before the sign-in was checked. Check the API key, and that SAGE_ZA_API_HOST is the site you sign in at.
verifyHints.404: Sage found no such record in this company. Records belong to one company: check the company ID and the record ID.
verifyHints.405: This Sage user has no access to that function. An invited user only reaches what their role allows; use the company owner or widen the role.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Sage allows 100 requests per minute per company and 5,000 per day. After a 429 the address is blocked for up to an hour: stop calling and try again later.

prerequisites: A Sage Business Cloud Accounting account of the South African edition (accounting.sageone.co.za), a user with its e-mail address and password, and an Accounting API key, which Sage issues on request through the developer page within about 2 working days.
instructions:
## Sage Accounting (South Africa)
This connector works with the **Sage Business Cloud Accounting API of the South African edition** (the former Sage One and Sage Pastel My Business Online, version 2.0.0), used in South Africa and by Sage Accounting customers in other African and international markets served from the same platform. It covers companies, customers, suppliers, items, tax invoices, quotes, supplier invoices, the chart of accounts, bank accounts and transactions, customer receipts, ageing and the financial reports. It is **not** the global Sage Accounting API of the UK, Ireland, North America and Europe (OAuth, api.accounting.sage.com): use the Sage Business Cloud connector for those.

**Setup (keys take up to 2 working days)**
1. Request an API key on https://accounting.sageone.co.za/marketing/developerprogram.aspx (Request your API Key). Sage issues one key per application; it looks like `39478ac6-ac2a-44d8-a31c-7e7e14af4de3`. Paste it into `SAGE_ZA_API_KEY`.
2. Pick the site you sign in at in `SAGE_ZA_API_HOST`: accounting.sageone.co.za for most accounts, or resellers.accounting.sageone.co.za when that is your login page.
3. Enter the e-mail address and password of a Sage Accounting user in `SAGE_ZA_USERNAME` and `SAGE_ZA_PASSWORD`. The API uses HTTP Basic authentication with the same sign-in as the web application, so a dedicated user with only the access the assistant needs is recommended. An invited user only reaches the functions their role allows (other calls answer 405).
4. Optional: put the ID of the company the assistant works in into `SAGE_ZA_COMPANY_ID`. Find it with `sage_accounting_za_list_companies`. Without it, pass `company_id` on every call.

**Where to start**: `sage_accounting_za_list_companies` shows the companies of the login and their ID. Every other tool works inside one company (`company_id`, or the default of the connector).

**Customers, suppliers, items**: `sage_accounting_za_list_customers`, `sage_accounting_za_get_customer`, `sage_accounting_za_list_suppliers`, `sage_accounting_za_get_supplier`, `sage_accounting_za_list_items`, `sage_accounting_za_get_item`. Create or change them with `sage_accounting_za_save_customer`, `sage_accounting_za_save_supplier` and `sage_accounting_za_save_item`.

**Sales and purchase documents**: `sage_accounting_za_list_tax_invoices` and `sage_accounting_za_get_tax_invoice` (sales invoices), `sage_accounting_za_list_quotes` and `sage_accounting_za_get_quote`, `sage_accounting_za_list_supplier_invoices` and `sage_accounting_za_get_supplier_invoice`. List tools return headers only unless `include_detail` is true. Write a quote with `sage_accounting_za_save_quote` and an invoice with `sage_accounting_za_save_tax_invoice`; preview totals first with `sage_accounting_za_calculate_quote` or `sage_accounting_za_calculate_tax_invoice`. A line names an item (LineType 0) or a ledger account (LineType 1) in SelectionId, with Quantity, a unit price and a TaxTypeId. If a saved document comes back with zero totals, pass the lines exactly as the calculate tool returned them.

**Ledger and banking**: `sage_accounting_za_list_accounts`, `sage_accounting_za_list_account_categories` and `sage_accounting_za_list_tax_types` describe the chart of accounts; `sage_accounting_za_save_account` adds or changes an account. `sage_accounting_za_list_bank_accounts`, `sage_accounting_za_list_bank_transactions` and `sage_accounting_za_list_customer_receipts` are read-only: this connector does not record receipts or payments and never moves money.

**Reports**: `sage_accounting_za_get_customer_ageing` and `sage_accounting_za_get_supplier_ageing` (who owes what, by age), `sage_accounting_za_list_outstanding_customer_documents`, `sage_accounting_za_get_profit_and_loss`, `sage_accounting_za_get_balance_sheet` and `sage_accounting_za_get_account_balances` (movement per account, like a trial balance). These are POST calls that only read.

**Saving**: a Save without `id` creates a record; with `id` it replaces that record. Sage stores the record as it is sent, so a field left out of an update can be reset: read the record first and pass what must stay in `extra_fields`. New records are active unless `active` is false. Nothing is deleted by this connector.

**Filtering and paging**: list tools accept a subset of OData. `filter` and `orderby` work on numbers, booleans and dates only, never on text (search names by reading the list). Date literals are written `DateTime'2026-01-31'`; if Sage rejects that form, try the quoted date alone. Every list is capped at **100 rows**: the answer is wrapped as TotalResults, ReturnedResults and Results; raise `skip` by 100 until you have TotalResults rows.

**Limits**: 100 requests per minute per company and 5,000 per day per user. Going over the minute limit blocks the IP address for an hour (HTTP 429), so keep to about one call per second and do not retry in a loop. 20 failed sign-ins within an hour block the user for 24 hours: after a 401, stop and have the credentials checked.

**Fields and formats**: IDs are integers. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Amounts are decimals in the company currency unless a customer or supplier has its own currency (see Customer_CurrencyId and the exchange rate on the document). Exclusive is the amount before tax, Tax the VAT and Total the amount including tax. Errors: 400 carries the validation messages, 402 means the Sage subscription expired, 404 that the record is not in this company, 409 that a record is in use.

tools.name: sage_accounting_za_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies this Sage login can open: ID, Name, CurrencySymbol, TaxNumber, RegisteredName, CountryId, Active, IsOwner, LockProcessingDate and contact details. The ID is the company_id every other tool needs. Read-only, at most 100 per call.

include_status.description: true: add the subscription Status of each company.

filter.description: OData $filter on numeric, boolean and date fields, e.g. `Active eq true`. Operators eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, combined with and / or. Date literals are written DateTime'2026-01-31'. Filtering on text fields is not supported by Sage.

orderby.description: OData $orderby on a numeric or date field, e.g. `ID desc`. Sorting on text fields is not supported.

top.description: Rows per call, at most 100 (Sage never returns more).

skip.description: Rows to skip for paging: 0, 100, 200 and so on until skip plus ReturnedResults reaches TotalResults.

tools.description: Movement per ledger account over a date range, like a trial balance: account ID, Description, CategoryId, CategoryDescription, Debit, Credit and Total. Read-only report, 100 rows per call; page with skip.

company_id.description: Company ID (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_companies). Leave out to use the default company set on the connector.

tools.name: sage_accounting_za_save_customer
tools.description: Create a customer, or update one when id is given. Returns the saved customer with its ID. A Save replaces the whole record: for an update read the customer first and pass the fields to keep in extra_fields. Show the user what will be saved and wait for confirmation.

id.description: ID of the customer to update. Leave out to create a new one.

email.description: E-mail address for documents and statements.

tax_reference.description: VAT or tax registration number of the customer.

credit_limit.description: Credit limit in the company currency.

active.description: false to mark the customer inactive (default true).

extra_fields.description: Other Customer fields by their API name, e.g. `{"PostalAddress01": "12 Long Street", "PostalAddress02": "Cape Town", "DeliveryAddress01": "Unit 4", "DefaultTaxTypeId": 3, "CurrencyId": 1}`. For an update pass the fields of sage_accounting_za_get_customer you want to keep: a Save replaces the whole record. The named parameters of this tool win over the same field here.

company_id.description: Company ID (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_companies). Leave out to use the default company set on the connector.

tools.name: sage_accounting_za_save_supplier
tools.description: Create a supplier, or update one when id is given. Returns the saved supplier with its ID. A Save replaces the whole record: for an update read the supplier first and pass the fields to keep in extra_fields. Show the user what will be saved and wait for confirmation.

id.description: ID of the supplier to update. Leave out to create a new one.

tax_reference.description: VAT or tax registration number of the supplier.

active.description: false to mark the supplier inactive (default true).

extra_fields.description: Other Supplier fields by their API name, e.g. `{"PostalAddress01": "PO Box 55", "PostalAddress02": "Durban", "DefaultTaxTypeId": 3, "CurrencyId": 1, "BusinessRegistrationNumber": "2019/123456/07"}`. For an update pass the fields of sage_accounting_za_get_supplier you want to keep: a Save replaces the whole record. The named parameters of this tool win over the same field here.

company_id.description: Company ID (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_companies). Leave out to use the default company set on the connector.

tools.name: sage_accounting_za_save_item
tools.description: Create an item (product or service), or update one when id is given. Returns the saved item with its ID. A Save replaces the whole record: for an update read the item first and pass the fields to keep in extra_fields. Does not change stock quantities.

id.description: ID of the item to update. Leave out to create a new one.

code.description: Item code (required, unique in the company).

price_exclusive.description: Selling price excluding tax, in the company currency.

unit.description: Unit of measure, e.g. each, hour, kg.

physical.description: true: a physical stock item whose quantities are tracked. false (default): a service item.

tax_type_id_sales.description: Tax type for sales (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_tax_types).

tax_type_id_purchases.description: Tax type for purchases (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_tax_types).

active.description: false to mark the item inactive (default true).

extra_fields.description: Other Item fields by their API name, e.g. `{"LastCost": 80.5, "ItemReportingGroupId_Sales": 11, "TextUserField1": "Shelf B"}`. For an update pass the fields of sage_accounting_za_get_item you want to keep: a Save replaces the whole record. The named parameters of this tool win over the same field here.

company_id.description: Company ID (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_companies). Leave out to use the default company set on the connector.

tools.name: sage_accounting_za_save_account
tools.description: Create a ledger account, or update one when id is given. Returns the saved account with its ID. The category decides where the account appears in the financial statements. A Save replaces the whole record.

id.description: ID of the account to update. Leave out to create a new one.

category.description: Account category as `{"ID": 5}` (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_account_categories). Required for a new account.

reporting_group_id.description: Reporting group the account is summarised under.

active.description: false to mark the account inactive (default true).

company_id.description: Company ID (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_companies). Leave out to use the default company set on the connector.

tools.name: sage_accounting_za_calculate_quote
tools.description: Work out the totals of a quote without saving it: returns the document with Exclusive, Tax, Total and Discount per line and for the whole quote. Use it to preview a quote before sage_accounting_za_save_quote. Nothing is stored.

reference.description: Reference shown on the document, e.g. the customer's order number.

inclusive.description: true: line prices include tax. Default false (exclusive).

discount_percentage.description: Discount on the whole document in percent.

Quantity.description: Quantity; must be 1 on an account line.

UnitPriceInclusive.description: Unit price including tax (for documents with inclusive true).

lines.description: Document lines, e.g. `[{"SelectionId": 501, "LineType": 0, "Description": "Consulting", "Quantity": 2, "UnitPriceExclusive": 950, "TaxTypeId": 3}]`. Lines returned by the calculate tool (with Exclusive, Tax and Total filled in) can be passed as they are.

extra_fields.description: Other quote fields by their API name, e.g. `{"PostalAddress01": "12 Long Street", "DeliveryAddress01": "Unit 4", "ExternalReference": "WEB-1001"}`. For an update pass the fields of sage_accounting_za_get_quote you want to keep: a Save replaces the whole record. The named parameters of this tool win over the same field here.

company_id.description: Company ID (ID of sage_accounting_za_list_companies). Leave out to use the default company set on the connector.

tools.name: sage_accounting_za_save_tax_invoice
tools.description: Create a tax invoice (sales invoice) for a customer, or update one when id is given. Returns the saved invoice with its ID, DocumentNumber, totals and AmountDue.
